reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS avg_price_3c,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS checks_in_window
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
alternatives:
WITH p AS (
  -- one row per price check in the period
  SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur,
    LAG(price_eur, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts) AS prev_1,
    LAG(price_eur, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts) AS prev_2
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
    AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
), c AS (
  -- one row per price check in the period
  SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur,
    price_eur + COALESCE(prev_1, 0) + COALESCE(prev_2, 0) AS total_3,
    1 + CASE WHEN prev_1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN prev_2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n
  FROM p
)
SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur, ROUND(total_3 / n, 2) AS avg_price_3c, n AS checks_in_window
FROM c

WITH w AS (
  -- one row per price check in the period
  SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur,
    AVG(price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_3,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
    AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur, ROUND(avg_3, 2) AS avg_price_3c, n AS checks_in_window
FROM w
